function.name: AudioTools.transcribe
function.description: Transcribe an audio or video file stored in the VM with the local Parakeet ASR service. Results up to 1000 characters are returned inline; longer results are saved to the fixed searchable audio.txt path documented in the audio skill and the API returns that path. Video audio is extracted as 16 kHz mono WAV with FFmpeg first.

vm_path.description: Absolute path of the audio or video file inside the VM. Supported video formats are MP4, MOV, and MKV. In API calls, use forward slashes for Windows paths, for example C:/Users/Docker/Desktop/Meeting.mp4, to avoid Python backslash escape errors.

function.name: AudioTools.transcribe_web_video
function.description: Transcribe speech from a video embedded in the currently opened Chrome webpage. Results up to 1000 characters are returned inline; longer results are saved to the fixed searchable audio.txt path documented in the audio skill and the API returns that path. The API discovers the current page when page_url is omitted, downloads the first embedded or streaming video with yt-dlp, and converts its audio to 16 kHz mono WAV before using Parakeet.

page_url.description: Optional HTTP(S) webpage or direct video URL. Omit this argument to use the webpage currently opened in Chrome.
